zh-CN.description: 可以重试此区域，或重新加载界面。界面恢复不会重启 mihomo，也不会修改已保存的配置。
zh-CN.draftCaution: 发生异常的区域中，未保存的编辑可能已经丢失。重新加载会丢弃其余未保存的编辑。
zh-CN.reloadConfirm: 重新加载界面会丢弃未保存的编辑。mihomo 会保持运行。是否继续？
zh-CN.saved: 已保存脱敏界面诊断，可用于排查此次故障。
zh-CN.actionFailed: 操作未完成，可从系统托盘重新加载界面。

en-US.appTitle: The interface could not be displayed
en-US.description: Retry this area or reload the interface. Recovery does not restart mihomo or change saved configuration.
en-US.draftCaution: Unsaved edits in the affected area may already be lost. Reloading discards any remaining unsaved edits.
en-US.reloadConfirm: Reloading discards unsaved edits. mihomo will keep running. Continue?
en-US.saved: Sanitized interface diagnostics have been saved for troubleshooting.
en-US.unavailable: Diagnostics could not be saved for this incident.
en-US.actionFailed: The action could not be completed. Try reloading from the system tray.
